content: Ma̱wana yey akabkun inaked Yeisuw Kelis; mapun yakamiy kwabkunis ked towen.
Kweim kalbaleb
Bo ikalin nuwag peinan kuninuways o kuyousis kaleiwag towen nasekeimiy.
Kweitan youd nises. Sivinag bukukwakinsa Kelis bikaleiwag tawaw wasigeis; tawaw bikaleiwags sikwavas wasigeis; Yowbad gog ikaleiwag Kelis waseg.
Kal taw bigeiguy o binitoug Yowbad waseg, igaw antanugweib wakunun, bo biyageg datoveks.
Kukin kal vin bigeiguy o binitoug Yowbad waseg, anakweim kalbaleb, mo namwan beivag anmwasin. Sinap towen ma̱wan magina kunun bibob beikous bikakuna̱duy; mo beivag anmwasin waseg.
Kukin vin bisikam anakweim kalbaleb, kadiloka mo bibob kunun beikous, bikakuna̱duy. O kukin nag sivinan bikakuna̱duy, kadiloka bisikam anakweim bwein.
Nag kadilok kuda̱taw bisen antanugweib buntuman tapwa̱loul wanuwan, peinan kuda̱taw magin ma̱wana Yowbad, yakawanan Yowbad silma̱nin, o kuda̱vin yakawanan taw silma̱nin.
Yowbad wanmugwana nibun kuda̱taw, taw waseg mo ibun kuda̱vin; ta-imug kuda̱vin; nag. Taw imug.
Ta-ibun taw, vin silma̱nin; nag. Ibun vin, taw silma̱nin.
Mapun, vin kadiloka bisikam anakweim bwein, peinan min-liba̱lab bikines.
DaGuyaws inaked waseg, gamag beivays ikous, kadilok vin son namwan asteiy bikaleiwags; awoum anmwa̱net gamag bikaleiwag.
Peinan Yowbad nibun vin, kuda̱taw waseg, wankuyeim vinay ikopwes tawaws; e, silawun youda babaw Yowbad waseg.
Ninoumiy yakamiy ama̱wan? Kadilok vin binitoug Yowbad waseg, anakweim kalbaleb? o nag? ama̱wan?

Kukwakins ven watinow sinapun; vinay bweina bisikams asikweim bwein, kunus vayva̱yov, silma̱nin yakawanes; tage awoum taw bisikam vin anakweim; kunun awoum bivag magina vin kunun, nag; bo beivag anmwasin.
Makaleiwag ma̱wan. Magat teitan gamag sivinan bitakamnimans sods, nag kweitan kaleiwag nises; nag. Nag kweitan kaleiwag nises tayakelesiys wasigeis.
DaGuyaws inakamkwam
Kweitan livan asekeimiy, o nag bakavasimiy youd towen waseg. Tutan kwatuyouns yakamiy, nag ivag amisinap bwein, singay kalbaleb.
Peinan mitapwa̱loul waseg, bo aligen kulivis mibod yakamiy, kuva̱ges bod babaw, o kakit bo asimounid livneimiy towen.
(Kadilok gog bukulivis va̱gan bitakakins kalisiy yakamiy amisinap bwein, o kalisiy asisinap kalbaleb.)
Kwatuyouns yakamiy nag bukukwams bwein daGuyaws inasagal, peinan tatanok tatanok yakamiy kukwams kaeimiy tatineimiy; teitan isesun-wan anamoun, tayuwein igovek, tatounun gog imoum, mo ikabala̱wein.

Tabta mibunatum sam bukukwams o bukumoums waseg, ne? O adok bukkwasigumis Yowbad angamag, tasiyas katuyouns nimeis; peinan ivag asimwasin tasiyas tasimavs. Aveiyag balivan? Tabta bakavasimiy youd towen silma̱nin? Adok nag.

DaGuyaws bo isekeig sinap towen nasekeimiy ma̱wan: misumkwey inavamul teitan bisilkod Yeisuw; e, boug towen, Yeisuw mo ikow bled wanaman, ikalin nuwan Yowbad waseg, ikiv, isekes beikams, ilana, “Towen woug pinamiy yakamiy. Kadiloka kuvva̱ges ma̱wan, va̱gan bukuninuweigs yey.”
Ikams ikous, mo ikow kwa̱vig, ilana, “Kwaviwen kwa̱vig silma̱nin kaleiwag kweivaw, buya̱vig tatoneig waseg. Kadiloka kuvva̱ges ma̱wan; igaw bukumwamwes, va̱gan gog bukuninuweigs.”
Igaw bukukwams kan towen, o kwa̱vig mkwaviwen bukumoums, bukukwa̱mats daGuyaws nakanig. E, kuvva̱ges ma̱wan ee... mo beiyum beim daGuyaws towen.
Mapuna kal beikam mav kan towen, o beimoum mav daGuyaws nakwa̱vig mkwaviwen, gamag towen ansinap kalbaleb, biyageg won daGuyaws, o biyageg buya̱vin daGuyaws.
Kadiloka tanuways adsinaps tatoneids, aveiyag bwein, o aveiyag kalbaleb; wankuyeim mo bitakams kan towen, o bitamoums mkwaviwen kwa̱vig.

Kal yak kukwam mav o kumoum mav, nag kukwakin won towen, igaw Yowbad mo bikatimop amsinap to kalbaleb. Tut towen, amisinap ma̱wan, mapuna kuguya̱gweys babaw yakamiy, o kukwatouns, o kumta̱mats mwasanin yakamiy.
Kukin bitaninuway adsinap, aw-sinap kalbaleb bitapiyev, Yowbad nag bimop adsinap kalbaleb.
Tut towen waseg daGuyaws bimop adsinap kalbaleb, va̱gan bika̱kin matads; tage igaw tut wanakougwaw nag bikamta̱nid. Bo bikamta̱nis sidayas takalbalebs; ya̱kids nag.
O sigwey, igaw bukukwams tapwa̱loul towen waseg, kadiloka bukwaymates simiyas.

Kukin teitan beivag anamoun, kadiloka beikam wanbunatum tatonen; va̱gan nag beivag amisinap kalbaleb. Beivag amisinap kalbaleb, Yowbad mo bimop amisinap to kalbaleb. Kaleiwag towen nasekeimiy. Kaleiwag mwasanin nisesus; igaw bawekeimiy, mo balivan.
